title: IYKYK (But AI Doesn’t): Automated Content Moderation Does Not Capture Communities’ Heterogeneous Attitudes Towards Reclaimed Language

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing in-group human annotations from Black social media users on tweets containing the reclaimed n-word against Perspective API's identity attack scores to measure model miscalibration and automated suppression.

Evaluating Perspective API's identity attack scores against human annotations from LGBTQIA+ individuals on tweets containing the reclaimed f-word to assess the model's ability to distinguish between reclaimed and derogatory usage.

Comparing in-group human annotations from women on tweets containing the reclaimed b-word against Perspective API's identity attack scores to determine the model's alignment with in-group attitudes and contextual nuances.
